product_overview: A student assessment app that guides learners from landing and profile setup into choosing a subject track, completing an adaptive assessment, and reviewing results. Students can also revisit past assessment reports from their dashboard.
core_goals: Set up a student profile and begin an assessment session
Choose between STEM Benchmark and English Literacy tracks
Answer adaptive multiple-choice assessment items and finish the test
View detailed results and past assessment history

features.name: Student Onboarding Flow
features.description: Lets a student enter the app, complete profile setup if needed, and choose a subject track before starting an assessment.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Start onboarding -> Enter login or registration details -> Fill in student profile information -> Choose a subject track -> Proceed to assessment
Navigate to / -> Start onboarding -> Fill in student profile information -> Choose STEM Benchmark -> Proceed to assessment
Navigate to / -> Start onboarding -> Fill in student profile information -> Choose English Literacy -> Proceed to assessment

features.name: Assessment Execution
features.description: Presents adaptive assessment questions, records a single choice per item, and advances through the test until completion.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Read the scenario -> Select one multiple-choice option -> Submit answer -> See the next scenario -> Repeat until assessment completes
Navigate to / -> Read the passage or scenario -> Select a multiple-choice option -> Submit answer -> Complete assessment

features.name: Results Dashboard
features.description: Shows a student’s assessment report breakdown and allows them to review prior assessment history.
user_flows: Navigate to /?dashboard -> See past assessment reports
Navigate to /?dashboard -> Open the dashboard -> Review competency breakdowns in the latest report -> Compare with past test history
